title: One refactor pass removes duplicated helpers, unchecked JSON boundaries, scripts logic and cli cycles after the adoption census
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114c merged t-rd8zndx, t-x4yx6df, t-x7nqpz9, t-mcfrwdf and t-15w1zrz into one refactor held until the adoption census shows which seams outside repositories stress.
Outcome: one git and one shell-text helper; zod at the five external JSON boundaries and no empty catch; logic under scripts/ moved into src/ behind layer boundaries; one ledger task-id parser without review or worker totals; src/cli is no cycle hub (neutral cli-kit, one command table).
Proof: architecture depth check and layer tests PASS; npm run fast PASS.

Progress: PR-title task-id parser unified in src/outcome/task-id.ts (outcome files). Remains: same parser in src/cli/pr-body.ts, src/cli/lane.ts, hook/scope.ts, state/*, scripts/claude/*; one git helper; one shell-text helper; zod at JSON boundaries and empty catches (src/hook/stop.ts, repo/contract.ts, deliver/transport.ts, cli/doctor-host.ts, scripts/claude/*); scripts/ logic into src/; cli-kit and one command table.
